description: Every talk on one day with its time (Mountain), room and the concepts it assumes. A talk is ready for a student when the student knows every concept it assumes; a talk that assumes nothing is ready for everyone.

configuration.query: FROM sessions | WHERE is_talk == true AND DATE_FORMAT("yyyy-MM-dd", day) == ?day | EVAL local = starts_at - 7 hours, time = DATE_FORMAT("EEE HH:mm", local) | SORT local | KEEP title, time, room, assumes | LIMIT 200

day.description: The day as YYYY-MM-DD. KubeCon talks run 2026-11-09 (Mon) to 2026-11-12 (Thu).
